ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flatbread-style crust, golden-tan with darker browned edges, topped with glossy orange-red sauce patches and melted pale yellow-white cheese with light browning spots; crust surface slightly bubbled, about 12 cm long and 5 cm wide at widest, roughly 1.5 cm thick, sits in upper-left of plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Cluster of bite-sized pieces with mottled golden-brown, slightly glossy, caramelized surfaces and darker charred spots; irregular chunks about 3 to 4 cm across, some with pale fibrous light-tan interior visible, interspersed with bright green finely chopped herb or scallion pieces and small dark crumbs, sits in lower-left of plate with one elongated piece extending to the right, roughly 10 cm across and 2 to 2.5 cm tall | 130
